entries.description: Were other ascetics and brahmins to see such a spectrum of noble ethics in themselves
entries.subject: Were
entries.object: ascetics and brahmins to see such a spectrum of noble ethics in themselves

spans.text: Evaṁ paripuṇṇañca, bho ānanda, ariyaṁ sīlakkhandhaṁ ito bahiddhā aññe samaṇabrāhmaṇā attani samanupasseyyuṁ, te tāvatakeneva attamanā assu: Were other ascetics and brahmins to see such a spectrum of noble ethics in themselves, they’d be delighted with just that much: ‘alamettāvatā, katamettāvatā, anuppatto no sāmaññattho, natthi no kiñci uttarikaraṇīyan’ti.
Evaṁ vutte, āyasmā ānando taṁ māṇavakaṁ etadavoca: When he had spoken, Venerable Ānanda said to him, ‘akālo kho, māṇavaka.
Evaṁ vutte, āyasmā ānando taṁ māṇavakaṁ etadavoca: When he had spoken, Venerable Ānanda said to him, ‘akālo kho, māṇavaka.
Such a complete spectrum of ethics cannot be seen among the other ascetics and brahmins.
“Yes, worthy sir,” replied the young student, and did as he was asked.

It also includes administering emetics, purgatives, expectorants, and phlegmagogues; administering ear-oils, eye restoratives, nasal medicine, ointments, and counter-ointments; surgery with needle and scalpel, treating children, prescribing root medicines, and herbal bandages.
